counterfactual_missing_items: Non-orthostatic headache pattern (absent; headaches worsen on standing)
Absence of epidural CSF collection (absent; CTM shows extradural contrast)
decisive_items: Ventral cervicothoracic epidural CSF collection extending from the mid cervical spine to mid thoracic level
Demonstrated extradural contrast spread at multiple cervical and thoracic levels
Patient reported worsening headaches upon standing
response.rationale: R1 is directly supported by CTM evidence of extradural contrast and a ventral cervicothoracic epidural CSF collection, with orthostatic headaches; R3's tonsillar descent is a secondary sign of CSF leak rather than primary Chiari. C1 is an append-only restatement of R1 using the same raw span and is discounted.

rejected.why: Append-only completion of R1 using the same raw span; correlated restatement, no independent evidence.
